pliki_config.prisma_schema:
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider  = "postgresql"
  url       = env("DATABASE_URL")
  directUrl = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model User {
  id                    String                       @id @default(cuid())
  email                 String                       @unique
  firstName             String
  lastName              String
  phone                 String?
  socialLink            String?
  password              String
  emailVerified         DateTime?
  createdAt             DateTime                     @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime                     @updatedAt
  verificationToken     String?
  resetToken            String?
  resetTokenExpiry      DateTime?
  profilePicture        String?
  instagramProfileId    String?
  linkedinProfileId     String?
  socialProfileType     SocialProfileType            @default(NONE)
  instagramUsername     String?
  authorDisplayName     String?
  authorLogoUrl         String?
  imageAiModel          String?                      @default("imagen-3")
  imageAiProvider       String?                      @default("google")
  textAiModel           String?                      @default("claude-3-haiku")
  textAiProvider        String?                      @default("anthropic")
  role                  Role                         @default(free)
  stripeCustomerId      String?                      @unique
  stripeSubscriptionId  String?                      @unique
  subscriptionStatus    String?
  paymentVerifiedAt     DateTime?
  nextBillingDate       DateTime?
  billingName           String?
  billingAddress        Json?
  cardLast4             String?
  cardBrand             String?
  companyName           String?
  taxId                 String?
  taxIdType             String?
  billingPreference     String?
  ebookSources          EbookSource[]
  ebooks                ebooks[]
  instagramAIAnalyses   InstagramCreatorAIAnalysis[]
  instagramAnalyses     InstagramCreatorAnalysis[]
  leads                 leads[]
  linkedinAIAnalyses    LinkedInCreatorAIAnalysis[]
  linkedinAnalyses      LinkedInCreatorAnalysis[]
  page_contents         page_content[]
  pages                 pages[]
  apiKeys               UserApiKey[]
  instagramProfile      InstagramProfileCheck?       @relation(fields: [instagramProfileId], references: [id])
  linkedinProfile       LinkedInProfileCheck?        @relation(fields: [linkedinProfileId], references: [id])

  @@map("users")
}

model UserApiKey {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId       String
  provider     String
  encryptedKey String
  keyHash      String
  isActive     Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt
  user         User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, provider])
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([provider])
  @@map("user_api_keys")
}

model InstagramProfileCheck {
  id                 String   @id @default(cuid())
  instagramUrl       String
  instagramId        String?
  username           String
  fullName           String?
  biography          String?
  followersCount     Int?
  followsCount       Int?
  postsCount         Int?
  profilePicUrl      String?
  profilePicUrlHD    String?
  isBusinessAccount  Boolean  @default(false)
  isPrivate          Boolean  @default(false)
  isVerified         Boolean  @default(false)
  businessCategory   String?
  checkedAt          DateTime @default(now())
  userIp             String?
  userAgent          String?
  highlightReelCount Int?
  users              User[]

  @@map("instagram_profile_checks")
}

model LinkedInProfileCheck {
  id               String   @id @default(cuid())
  linkedinUrl      String
  firstName        String?
  lastName         String?
  fullName         String?
  headline         String?
  aboutExcerpt     String?
  connectionsCount Int?
  followersCount   Int?
  profilePicUrl    String?
  jobTitle         String?
  companyName      String?
  companyIndustry  String?
  location         String?
  topSkills        String?
  checkedAt        DateTime @default(now())
  userIp           String?
  userAgent        String?
  users            User[]

  @@map("linkedin_profile_checks")
}

model InstagramCreatorAnalysis {
  id                 String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId             String
  username           String
  postId             String
  caption            String
  likesCount         Int      @default(0)
  commentsCount      Int      @default(0)
  videoPlayCount     Int?
  videoDuration      Int?
  commenterUsernames Json
  createdAt          DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt          DateTime @updatedAt
  user               User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, postId])
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([username])
  @@index([postId])
  @@map("instagram_creator_analysis")
}

model LinkedInCreatorAnalysis {
  id                 String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId             String
  username           String
  postUrn            String
  postDate           String
  postText           String
  totalReactions     Int      @default(0)
  commentsCount      Int      @default(0)
  commenterHeadlines String
  createdAt          DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt          DateTime @updatedAt
  user               User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, postUrn])
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([username])
  @@index([postUrn])
  @@map("linkedin_creator_analysis")
}

model InstagramCreatorAIAnalysis {
  id                 String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId             String
  username           String
  profileDescription String
  competencies       Json
  uniqueTalent       Json
  metadata           Json
  postsAnalyzed      Int
  aiModel            String   @default("claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022")
  version            String   @default("2.0")
  createdAt          DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt          DateTime @updatedAt
  user               User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, username])
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([username])
  @@index([userId, username])
  @@map("instagram_creator_ai_analysis")
}

model LinkedInCreatorAIAnalysis {
  id                   String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId               String
  username             String
  profileDescription   String
  businessCompetencies Json
  expertiseNiche       Json
  metadata             Json
  postsAnalyzed        Int
  aiModel              String   @default("claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022")
  version              String   @default("2.0-linkedin")
  createdAt            DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt            DateTime @updatedAt
  user                 User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, username])
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([username])
  @@index([userId, username])
  @@map("linkedin_creator_ai_analysis")
}

model ebook_chapters {
  id           Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  ebook_id     Int
  title        String    @db.VarChar(255)
  content      String?
  position     Int
  image_url    String?   @db.VarChar(1024)
  image_prompt String?
  created_at   DateTime? @default(now()) @db.Timestamp(6)
  updated_at   DateTime? @default(now()) @db.Timestamp(6)
  ebooks       ebooks    @relation(fields: [ebook_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([ebook_id], map: "idx_ebook_chapters_ebook_id")
  @@index([ebook_id, position], map: "idx_ebook_chapters_position")
}

model ebooks {
  id                              Int              @id @default(autoincrement())
  title                           String           @db.VarChar(255)
  draft_url                       String?          @unique @db.VarChar(255)
  status                          String?          @default("draft") @db.VarChar(50)
  visitors                        Int?             @default(0)
  created_at                      DateTime?        @default(now()) @db.Timestamp(6)
  updated_at                      DateTime?        @default(now()) @db.Timestamp(6)
  x_amz_meta_user_id              Int?
  x_amz_meta_user_cognito_sub     String?          @db.VarChar(255)
  x_amz_meta_user_first_name      String?          @db.VarChar(100)
  x_amz_meta_user_last_name       String?          @db.VarChar(100)
  x_amz_meta_user_email           String?          @db.VarChar(255)
  x_amz_meta_user_role            String?          @db.VarChar(50)
  x_amz_meta_user_status          String?          @db.VarChar(50)
  x_amz_meta_user_supervisor_code String?          @db.VarChar(100)
  x_amz_meta_user_created_at      DateTime?        @db.Timestamp(6)
  x_amz_meta_user_updated_at      DateTime?        @db.Timestamp(6)
  category                        String?          @db.VarChar(100)
  short_desc                      String?
  subtitle                        String?
  description                     String?
  cover_image_url                 String?
  cover_image_prompt              String?
  userId                          String?
  ai_generation_timestamp         DateTime?        @db.Timestamp(6)
  image_ai_model                  String?          @db.VarChar(100)
  image_ai_provider               String?          @db.VarChar(50)
  text_ai_model                   String?          @db.VarChar(100)
  text_ai_provider                String?          @db.VarChar(50)
  authorDisplayName               String?          @db.VarChar(200)
  authorLogoUrl                   String?          @db.VarChar(1024)
  cover_image_webp_url            String?
  final_mockup_url                String?
  ebook_chapters                  ebook_chapters[]
  sources                         EbookSource[]
  user                            User?            @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  page_contents                   page_content[]
  pages                           pages[]

  @@index([x_amz_meta_user_id], map: "idx_ebooks_user_id")
}

model EbookSource {
  id          Int        @id @default(autoincrement())
  ebook_id    Int
  user_id     String
  sourceType  SourceType
  url         String     @db.VarChar(1024)
  title       String     @db.VarChar(512)
  content     String
  sourceLabel String?    @db.VarChar(100)
  metadata    Json?
  createdAt   DateTime   @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime   @updatedAt
  ebook       ebooks     @relation(fields: [ebook_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user        User       @relation(fields: [user_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([ebook_id, url])
  @@index([ebook_id])
  @@index([user_id])
  @@map("ebook_sources")
}

model pages {
  id               String        @id @db.VarChar(255)
  title            String        @db.VarChar(255)
  headline         String?
  creator          String?       @db.VarChar(255)
  visits           Int?          @default(0)
  leadsCount       Int?          @default(0) @map("leads")
  type             String?       @db.VarChar(50)
  status           String        @db.VarChar(50)
  createdAt        DateTime?     @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  url              String?       @db.VarChar(255)
  draft_url        String?       @db.VarChar(255)
  coverImage       String?       @db.VarChar(255)
  x_amz_meta_title String?       @db.VarChar(255)
  userId           String?       @db.VarChar(255)
  ebookId          Int?
  color            String?       @db.VarChar(50)
  leads            leads[]
  content          page_content?
  ebook            ebooks?       @relation(fields: [ebookId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade, map: "fk_ebook")
  user             User?         @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], map: "fk_user")
}

model page_content {
  id                            String   @id @default(cuid())
  pageId                        String   @unique
  userId                        String
  ebookId                       Int?
  hero_headline                 String?
  hero_subheadline              String?
  hero_description              String?
  benefits_item_0_title         String?
  benefits_item_0_text          String?
  benefits_item_1_title         String?
  benefits_item_1_text          String?
  benefits_item_2_title         String?
  benefits_item_2_text          String?
  benefits_item_3_title         String?
  benefits_item_3_text          String?
  testimonials_item_0_text      String?
  testimonials_item_0_author    String?
  testimonials_item_0_role      String?
  testimonials_item_1_text      String?
  testimonials_item_1_author    String?
  testimonials_item_1_role      String?
  testimonials_item_2_text      String?
  testimonials_item_2_author    String?
  testimonials_item_2_role      String?
  content_chapter_0_title       String?
  content_chapter_0_description String?
  content_chapter_1_title       String?
  content_chapter_1_description String?
  content_chapter_2_title       String?
  content_chapter_2_description String?
  form_title                    String?
  faq_item_0_question           String?
  faq_item_0_answer             String?
  faq_item_1_question           String?
  faq_item_1_answer             String?
  faq_item_2_question           String?
  faq_item_2_answer             String?
  createdAt                     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt                     DateTime @updatedAt
  ebook                         ebooks?  @relation(fields: [ebookId], references: [id])
  page                          pages    @relation(fields: [pageId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user                          User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([pageId])
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([ebookId])
  @@map("page_contents")
}

model leads {
  id             Int       @id @default(autoincrement()) @map("lead_id")
  pageId         String?   @map("page_id")
  pageName       String?   @map("page_name")
  leadType       String?   @map("lead_type")
  userId         String?   @map("user_id")
  supervisorCode String?   @map("supervisor_code") @db.VarChar(255)
  leadDate       DateTime? @map("lead_date") @db.Date
  leadTime       DateTime? @map("lead_time") @db.Time(6)
  leadName       String    @map("lead_name")
  leadEmail      String    @map("lead_email")
  leadPhone      String?   @map("lead_phone")
  leadTimestamp  DateTime? @default(now()) @map("lead_timestamp") @db.Timestamptz(6)
  buyNow         Boolean?  @default(false) @map("buy_now")
  status         String?   @default("b_contact")
  comment        String?
  page           pages?    @relation(fields: [pageId], references: [id])
  user           User?     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])

  @@map("leads")
}

enum Role {
  admin
  demo
  free
  free_ver
  rookie
  creator
  unlimited
  payd
  premium
  GOD
}

enum SourceType {
  WEB
  PDF
}

enum SocialProfileType {
  INSTAGRAM_ONLY
  LINKEDIN_ONLY
  BOTH
  NONE
}
